source: Manual archaeology pass over Realmz outdoor render, LOS, setupnewgame, and save/load sources
topic: Outdoor visibility, dark levels, and generated site cache

realmzSourceAnchors.finding: New-game setup clears site to zero and writes one site grid into each outdoor CL record after door, field, and randlevel.
Outdoor CL records are door + field + randlevel + site; dungeon CD records are door + field + randlevel.
If randlevel.uselos and site is false, Realmz draws black tile 252; if randlevel.isdark, it applies a 320x320 darkness mask around the party position.
Visibility rays normalize map field values, consult mapstats[hit].los, and mark visible cells site[x][y] = TRUE.
Saved games preserve CL records including site; saveland writes site only for outdoor records.

sourceRuntimeSplit.editorTreatment: Writable map flag and tileset selection.
Writable map flag with party-position-dependent preview.
Writable map flag with generated-site preview.

editorImplications: Dark Level and Use LOS controls are real source-backed Data RD fields.
Canvas effects should be preview modes because both features depend on party position and generated site state.
Use LOS should preview unknown cells from a chosen focal point, not imply a static tile palette change.
Dark Level should preview a party-centered mask, not change landlook tile art.
Providence should not create or export authored site data; Realmz creates site in CL during setupnewgame.
followUpUi: Add preview focal point choices: scenario start, selected cell, selected map record start, or manual coordinate.
Add LOS-blocking tile overlay from mapstats.los.
Keep generated site cache in Source Evidence only.
confidenceDebt: Divinity binary/manual evidence is still needed to prove whether Divinity offered a visual preview for dark/LOS flags.
Dungeon use of randlevel.isdark exists as a stored flag, but this pass focused on outdoor centerpict/site behavior.
